app_type: hybrid_fullstack (Data-heavy government admin dashboard / Performance Tracking System)
design_archetype: GOVERNMENT & JUDICIAL PRESTIGE (High Density Tactical & Formal Institutional)

theme_strategy.light_mode_vibe: Clean, crisp, authoritative, high-trust government portal with deep emerald green header, subtle slate cards, crisp gold accents, and zero-bleed opacity.
theme_strategy.dark_mode_vibe: Deep obsidian and slate navy background with crisp emerald borders, high-contrast gold badges, and glowing data indicators.

typography.monospace_font_family: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.page_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.small_label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

rules: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for primary page headings to give a modern Indonesian institutional feel.
Never use default raw black text; use slate-900 or slate-800 for high readability.
All metric values and financial or judicial numbers must use monospace or tabular numbers font-variant (font-mono or font-numeric).

forbidden_colors: pure transparent headers with content underneath

header.style: Institutional Top Banner combined with sticky sub-header
header.subtitle: Sistem Tracking Kinerja Pengadilan Negeri Sukadana

charts: Capaian Kinerja per Kelompok Indikator (Bar Chart)
filters: Periode Reporting (Triwulan I - IV, Semestral, Tahunan)
Kelompok Indikator (Kepaniteraan, Kesekretariatan, Pelayanan Publik, Pelanggaran)

capabilities: Set target, unit (%), score, formula expression, weighted sub-components
Map to SIPP data source or internal log

input_data.dynamic_forms: Form fields dynamically adapt according to indicator type: Percentage (pembilang & penyebut), Composite (multi-component values & auto-weights), Survey (skor survei & jumlah responden), Manual (nilai aktual & catatan)
input_data.evidence_upload_simulation: Supports file evidence upload / lampiran pendukung
input_data.approval_trigger: Draft saving vs Submit for Approval

engine_features: Automated recalculation of all 17 indicators with gap calculation (Capaian = Realisasi / Target * 100%)
Composite index detail drawer showing breakdown of weight contributions
Status Badges: TERCAPAI (≥100%), TERLAMPAI (>105%), BELUM TERCAPAI (<100%), BELUM DIHITUNG
Approval timeline step tracker: Draft → Submitted (Diajukan) → Verified (Diverifikasi) → Approved (Disetujui) → Locked (Dikunci)

periode.lock_mechanism: Lock/Unlock period toggle with confirmation modal and administrative security badge

sumber_data.sipp_mapping: Mapping configuration between KINTRACK KPIs and SIPP (Sistem Informasi Penelusuran Perkara) database tables/APIs e.g., perkara_masuk, perkara_putus, minutasi_terlambat, e-court_ratio

court_gavel.description: Palu Hakim & Buku Hukum - Official Government Judicial Background
court_gavel.usage: Login Screen Side Visual & Header Official Seal Banner

officer_avatar_1.usage: Profile avatars in Penanggung Jawab module

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: MANDATORY: Every interactive element, filter input, button, table row, badge, calculation trigger, and modal MUST contain a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all primary UI components use Indonesian Bahasa labels exactly as requested in the problem statement.
Structure the dashboard using Bento / High-Density Grid layout for data metrics and indicators.

Make sure the 17 performance indicators represent real Indonesian District Court IKU metrics (e.g., Persentase Perkara Pidana Diselesaikan Tepat Waktu, Indeks Kepuasan Masyarakat / SKM, Persentase Perkara e-Court, Persentase Minutasi Perkara Tepat Waktu, Penyerapan Anggaran DIPA 01 & DIPA 04, Indeks Kinerja Pelayanan Publik, etc.).
Include mock data that is realistic and complete so calculations, gaps, charts, and report exports look fully populated.
Ensure Sonner toasts are implemented for all actions (Save, Submit, Verify, Approve, Lock, Export, Sync SIPP).
Validate that all interactive controls have explicit hover/focus text colors and WCAG compliant background contrasts.
DO NOT use raw transparent backgrounds in sticky nav or dropdown overlays; always use solid/backdrop-blur-xl with border.
